summary: Sprint 4 Admin OS Domain Expansion — all 4 new domain pages (AI Operations, Communications, Identity & Security, Governance & Trust) render correctly with the shared DomainLandingShell. All required testids present (root, verdict, verdict-pill, verdict-summary, last-refreshed, verdict-sources, refresh, back-adminos, search, all filters, all sections, all cards + child testids, all maintenance actions with hrefs, all trust-gap rows). Evidence drawer opens with all 7 sub-testids on card click. AdminOS card destinations updated correctly (all 4 hrefs verified). OCC aggregator drilldowns verified via /api/admin/occ/health: email_v2 → /admin/communications, ai_gateway → /admin/ai-operations, sessions → /admin/identity-security, governance + production_certification → /admin/governance-trust. Back-to-Admin-OS button works. Tablet + desktop viewports OK. Zero console errors observed on any page. No raw UTC ISO strings rendered.

integration_issues.issue: On /admin/communications, /admin/identity-security, /admin/governance-trust the last-refreshed stamp text did not change between two consecutive refreshes because formatPlatformTime renders minute-level precision (e.g. 'Jul 10, 2026 · 12:26 AM') and both fetches completed inside the same clock minute. Underlying refetch itself works (state timestamp updated internally; ai-operations passed because its refresh crossed a minute boundary). Non-blocking cosmetic — consider showing seconds or a spinner→checkmark micro-indicator. Not a functional bug.

action_items: OPTIONAL (non-blocking): Include seconds in last-refreshed stamp OR flash a transient 'Refreshed' indicator so users see visible confirmation when two refreshes land in the same clock minute.
critical_code_review_comments: DomainLandingShell is a clean declarative shell — no per-page design drift. All 4 manifests read cleanly at ~120 lines each, well under the 700-line threshold.
Evaluator try/catch in shell falls back to unknownCard() — defensive and honest.
authHeaders() properly reads token from adminAuth (X-Admin-Token). No hardcoded URLs; uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
Refresh uses new Date().toISOString() but is only rendered via formatPlatformTime() — TRACK-27.03-EXEMPT comment present.
Maintenance actions are <Link> deep-links only, no inline mutation — matches spec.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (17/17 sub-checks per page across 4 pages; 4/4 AdminOS card destinations; 5/5 OCC drilldowns; back-adminos; tablet+desktop; zero console errors)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 4 complete. If retesting, use the login flow above (multi-login → set masci.admin.token in localStorage → navigate to /admin/*). The 4 new pages use testidPrefixes admin-ai-ops, admin-communications, admin-identity-security, admin-governance-trust. Each has: -root, -verdict[-pill|-summary|-highest|-sources], -count-{green|yellow|red|unknown}, -last-refreshed, -refresh, -back-adminos, -search, -filter-{all|red|yellow|unknown|green}, -sections, -section-{id}[-status|-empty], -card-{id}[-title|-status|-summary|-endpoint|-action|-stamp], -action-{id}, -{gap-id}, -drawer[-title|-status|-endpoint|-checked-at|-reason|-payload|-action|-drilldown]. OCC aggregator IDs: email_v2, ai_gateway, sessions, governance, production_certification (NOT email_routing_v2 / active_sessions / governance_summary — that was my initial guess; the correct backend ids are shorter).
rca of the issue: Refresh stamp appearing identical across two clicks is not a bug — formatPlatformTime() rounds to the minute for display; when both refresh clicks complete within the same UTC minute the text is byte-identical although the underlying refetch executed. Confirmed by the ai-operations page which crossed a minute boundary and did visibly update. Recommendation: purely cosmetic — expose seconds or a transient 'refreshed' badge.
